# Part 16 · Paid Twice. Key and All.

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dd9E6QoR3V6/) · Published 1 Oct 2026

> How do you stop a refund agent paying twice when it already has an idempotency key?

A customer emails about a missing parcel, then asks again on chat. Two tickets wake two agent runs, each builds its own request with its own key, and you pay ₹1,200 twice.

![Whiteboard for Part 16](canvas.jpg)

## The three rules

1. Key every action on the thing it changes, not the ticket or the run. For a refund, that's the order line.
2. Record every action in your own ledger before you call out, and check the ledger, not the downstream status.
3. Allow one automatic run for any action you can't undo. A second refund goes to a human.

## The code

[`refund_ledger.py`](refund_ledger.py). A SQLite ledger keyed on the order line. The second run gets "already started" and moves no money; a second real refund goes to a human.

```bash
python refund_ledger.py
```

Standard library only. Running it executes the self-test.
